purpose: Machine-readable cumulative contract for MASTER MARKET. Existing required data, checks, and user-visible output blocks must survive future version upgrades unless the user explicitly orders removal.

no_silent_omission.rule: NO EXISTING REQUIRED DATA OR OUTPUT MAY BE REMOVED, RENAMED INTO INVISIBILITY, OR SILENTLY SKIPPED WITHOUT EXPLICIT USER INSTRUCTION.
no_silent_omission.missing_data_behavior: KEEP THE ITEM VISIBLE AND MARK N/A OR CONFIRMATION_FAILED; NEVER DELETE THE ROW/BLOCK BECAUSE A SOURCE FAILED.
no_silent_omission.version_upgrade_behavior: COPY FORWARD ALL REQUIRED ITEMS FROM THE PRIOR FINAL CONTRACT, THEN ADD NEW ITEMS. DELETION REQUIRES EXPLICIT USER COMMAND.
no_silent_omission.score_behavior: Recovered auxiliary blocks do not create new score weights or change thresholds. News only affects an existing owner axis after independent confirmation; opinion blocks have score weight 0.
no_silent_omission.git_behavior: Existing data collectors and outputs must not be modified or deleted as a side effect of prompt/version upgrades. GitHub data layers remain read-only providers unless the user explicitly orders a code change.

change_management.rule: RECOMMEND FREELY, EXPLAIN TRADE-OFFS, PRESERVE BY DEFAULT, EXECUTE DESTRUCTIVE OR CONTRACT-BREAKING CHANGES ONLY WITH USER APPROVAL.
allowed_recommendations: deprecation or replacement of a weak source

execution_policy.additive_non_destructive: may be proposed proactively; implementation should preserve the locked information set unless the user explicitly authorizes a contract change
execution_policy.destructive_or_contract_breaking: requires explicit user approval before execution
execution_policy.score_weight_or_threshold_change: requires explicit user approval before execution
execution_policy.removal_or_replacement_of_existing_requi: requires explicit user approval before execution
execution_policy.production_github_collector_change: if unavoidable for compatibility or source/API drift, explain why, what changes, what is preserved, expected benefit, and regression risk; obtain user approval before destructive or behavior-changing execution
execution_policy.output_layout_change: recommend freely; until approved, do not hide or delete required information

change_management.flexibility_intent: Anti-omission is a preservation default, not a ban on intelligent recommendations or future improvements.

change_windows.column_order_rule: For the four locked summary tables, show 1D then 3D then 7D. Existing 7D is preserved.
change_windows.data_rule: Use only actual stored values, actual cumulative flow, or same-source comparable observations. No interpolation or reconstruction. Missing windows remain visible as N/A.

macro_liquidity: Treasury Buyback actual accepted/settlement when available
secondary_confirmation: STH-SOPR/on-chain confirmation - no threshold crossing by itself

source_policy.coinness: EARLY_DETECTION_ONLY. Coinness can trigger investigation but cannot alone change the score. Confirm important claims with official/primary source, Reuters, exchange/project source, or another independent source before score impact.
source_policy.market_vault: Historical comparison cache only; same metric + same source deltas only.
source_policy.derivatives_github: Read 1H/4H/24H OI/funding history every run when fresh. Venue-locked comparison only; no cross-venue delta.
source_policy.whale_github: Use Hyperliquid official API-derived position-size history when fresh. No inferred identity. Missing API result is not proof of closure.
source_policy.stablecoin: Supply increase is not actual buying. Treasury-to-Exchange and spot-buy path are separate confirmations.
source_policy.treasury_buyback: Maximum announced amount is not actual accepted amount and is not QE. Use actual accepted/settlement/net-liquidity effect when available.
source_policy.optional_failure: Do not loop/retry indefinitely. Mandatory sufficient => continue and expose N/A explicitly.
